description: For \(f:\mathbb N\to\mathbb N\), the unary paired definition of primitive recursiveness agrees with the finite-arity definition applied to the one-coordinate function \(v\mapsto f(v_0)\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.UniversalComputation.unary_primitive_iff (f : ℕ → ℕ) :
  (Nat.Primrec' fun v => f (v.get 0)) ↔ Nat.Primrec f
